title: Google Play Compliance & Account Deletion Framework
releaseNotes: Google Play Compliance: Completely removed in-app update popups and external APK download prompts in accordance with Google Play Developer Policies.
Account & Data Deletion: Added a self-service account and cloud data deletion tool in Settings, paired with an official web request portal.
Permission Hardening: Streamlined Android permissions to exact alarm and battery guidelines while maintaining reliable timetable notifications.
